heading: Onsen Facilities

items.name: Large Public Bath
items.description: Our large public bath, fed continuously with fresh spring water, has three tubs of different temperatures for both men and women — hot, warm, and skin-temperature. Take your time and choose the one that suits how you feel that day.
items.hours: 13:00–9:30 the next day (closed 23:00–23:30 and 9:30–13:00 for cleaning)

items.name: Bubble Bath
items.description: Enjoy our soothing bubble bath. Pair it with the onsen for an even deeper level of relaxation.

items.name: Open-air Bath
items.description: Soak in our open-air bath while feeling the breeze off the lake. Enjoy views of Lake Toya and the surrounding mountains by day, and quiet steam under the starry sky by night.

notes: Private baths and saunas are not available.
